Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Samyak Rout
Message:
fix(db): auto-apply the apps registry via migration (idempotent + persisted) (#59) (#6)

The Admin Apps grid is DB-driven from tesserix_admin.apps, but the registry rows
lived only in db/seeds/apps.sql — which db:migrate does NOT run (migrations only).
So the rows were applied by hand at cutover and a DB refresh dropped them; that's
how the HomeChef tile vanished. Following the repo's existing seed-as-migration
pattern (0006_seed_lead_templates), add 0012_seed_apps_registry.sql: an idempotent
INSERT ... ON CONFLICT for mark8ly + homechef that db:migrate applies automatically
on deploy. Now the registry persists across DB refreshes without a manual re-seed.
db/seeds/apps.sql stays for ad-hoc use with a note to keep it in sync with 0012.
